key.name: shake
key.description: grow swells the pointer to three and a half times its size while you shake it, beacon grows it a little and sends rings out from where it is, and off does nothing.

key.name: dense
key.summary: A larger pointer on dense screens
key.description: On a screen with small pixels shown at 100%, the pointer is drawn one size larger (32 in place of 24). A size chosen in Settings is kept.
